name: Small phytoplankton
description: Microscopic drifting algae smaller than 10 micrometres - the grass of the upwelling-driven sea, blooming where winds draw deep nutrients to the surface. Functional group aggregating the source's small-phytoplankton compartment (the source split phytoplankton by cell size, after Probyn 1992, to model upwelling effects on the food web).
